nodes.label: ai-service container
nodes.rationale: Reaches the Java backend at http://host.docker.internal:8080 because the backend runs on the host rather than inside this compose network, and waits on qdrant service_healthy before starting so the first ingest cannot fail on a cold vector store.

nodes.label: qdrant container
nodes.rationale: Healthcheck probes the TCP port directly via /dev/tcp rather than an HTTP path, with a 20s start_period, and persists to the qdrant_data volume so embeddings survive container recreation.

nodes.label: inngest dev container
nodes.rationale: Runs `inngest dev -u http://ai-service:8000/api/inngest`, so the dev server discovers the FastAPI app's Inngest handler by its in-network service name.

nodes.label: Scoring Weight Environment Configuration
nodes.rationale: SCORING_SKILL_WEIGHT 0.40, EXPERIENCE 0.20, EDUCATION 0.10, SEMANTIC 0.30 plus MIN_SKILL_MATCH_THRESHOLD 0.3 and versioned PROMPT_VERSION/SCORING_VERSION are injected as env vars, so scoring can be retuned per environment and past scores remain attributable to a version.
